guide: Open Settings and type your agency name and your own limits in the yellow cells: days before and after the due date, the most windows of one doula at once, your monthly cap and the backup pay.
Fill Team and Doulas first. A solo doula keeps one row in each and leaves the backup sheets empty: the same sheets still count windows, caps and time off.
Write each client in Clients (name, area, due date, doula, backup) and each client window in On-Call Windows. The window days, the cover check and the overlap check fill in by themselves.
Watch Daily On-Call Load, Weekly On-Call Load and Busiest Weeks. They count the windows for you and flag 2 or more windows of one doula and the limit you set.
Use Capacity by Month and Capacity by Doula and Month before you say yes: they show the due dates booked against the cap for every month and every doula.
Check Backup Cover Check and Backup Load by Week every Monday. They list windows with no backup named and backups carrying too many windows.
Type each new request in Date Requests. The verdict says yes, yes with backup booked, or decline or waitlist, from the windows and caps already booked.
Log time off in Time Off and look at Time-Off Clashes. Backup Rota and Backup Call-Outs hold the weekly stipend and the pay when a backup attends.
Use Overlap Scenario and Backup Named Share to test a month when every birth lands in the same week and to see how many windows still need a backup.
Use the 18 calculators for decisions: take the client, cap the month, test the overlap, rank the backups, pay a backup, plan time off and forecast call-outs.
Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and tap a message link to send a text with the dates already written in.
Read the On-Call Dashboard and its charts every week. The sheet counts hours, dates, money and capacity only; it holds no medical detail and promises no outcome.

listing.title: Doula Business On-Call Schedule and Backup Cover Excel Template: Capacity Planner, Overlap Check, Backup Rota, Time Off
listing.headline: See who is on call, when, and who covers, before you say yes
listing.description:
Run the on-call side of a doula business in one Excel workbook. Built for an owner-doula who also takes clients, an agency with contracted and backup doulas, or a solo doula who wants the same sheets with one doula and no backup rota. A doula is a non-medical support person who helps a client before, during or after a birth. The on-call window is the days around the estimated due date when the doula keeps themselves free, and a backup doula is a second doula who attends if the assigned one cannot.

On-Call Windows holds the window of every client with the doula, the backup, the dates and the contact hours; the window days, the cover check and the overlap check fill in by themselves. Daily On-Call Load, Weekly On-Call Load and Busiest Weeks count the windows for you and flag two or more windows of one doula. Capacity by Month and Capacity by Doula and Month set due dates booked against your own caps. Backup Cover Check, Backup Load by Week and the Backup Rota show every window with its backup. Date Requests answers each new request: yes, yes with backup booked, or decline or waitlist.

18 calculators cover the on-call forecast, can I take this client, the monthly cap, an overlap scenario, backup cover, backup pay when a backup attends, a time-off planner, backup ranking, window length, rota balance, back-to-back due dates, income left open, unnamed backup alerts, a swap finder, a call-out forecast, freed dates and the peak season. Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and send 34 ready text messages to clients, enquirers, doulas, backup doulas, the admin and the accountant.

This is part four of the Doula Business suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, with a demo copy full of sample data to explore first. Clients appear by name, area and due date only, with no medical detail. It helps you keep track of dates, hours, money and capacity and does not promise results. Check your local rules for privacy, contracts and records.

documents.title: On-call window letter for a client
paragraphs: On-call window letter of {set:company}, dated {today}. Dear {col:oncall.client}, this letter sets out your on-call window and who to call.

Your doula is {col:oncall.doula}, phone {col:oncall.doula_phone}. Your backup doula is {col:oncall.backup}, phone {col:oncall.backup_phone}. A backup doula is a second doula who attends if the assigned one cannot.

The on-call window is the days around your estimated due date when the doula keeps themselves free. Your estimated due date is {col:oncall.edd}, a date you gave us and we use only to plan the window. Your window starts on {col:oncall.oncall_start} and ends on {col:oncall.oncall_end}, {col:oncall.window_days} days in all.
Please call or write when you need your doula. For anything medical, ask your care provider. This letter sets out dates and contacts only.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own business. Check your local rules for privacy, consent and records.

documents.title: Backup doula introduction letter
paragraphs: Letter of {set:company}, dated {today}. Dear {col:oncall.client}, we would like you to meet your backup doula, {col:oncall.backup}.

Your doula for the window from {col:oncall.oncall_start} to {col:oncall.oncall_end} is {col:oncall.doula}. {col:oncall.backup} attends only if {col:oncall.doula} cannot, and the agency tells you at once if that happens.
You can reach your backup doula on {col:oncall.backup_phone}. Your doula is on {col:oncall.doula_phone}. Please save both numbers before the window opens.
We are glad to look after you.

Windows of your own that are open on the start day: {col:oncall.overlap}, against a limit of {set:max_oncall_overlap}. Overlap check: {col:oncall.overlap_flag}. Windows in your next 30 days: {col:oncall.load_30}. Your next window opens on {col:oncall.next_start}.
Tell the owner-doula early if you need a backup or a day off. Keep yourself free for the whole window.

Windows opening: {col:capm.windows_opening}. Backup stipends: {col:capm.stipend}, planned {col:capm.stipend_plan}. Backup call-out pay: {col:capm.callout_pay}.
Write the decision below: sell more of this month, waitlist new requests or ask for more backup cover.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own business. Check your local rules for privacy, consent and records.

documents.title: Overlap plan note for a month
paragraphs: Overlap plan of {set:company}, dated {today}. Month: {col:overlap_scn.month}.

Due dates in the month: {col:overlap_scn.due_dates}. If all of them land in the same 7 days, each doula attends one, so {col:overlap_scn.extra} births need a backup. Backups available: {col:overlap_scn.backups}. Short by: {col:overlap_scn.short_by}. Verdict: {col:overlap_scn.verdict}.
Decide below who calls the backups, whether to waitlist new requests for the month and which windows to move.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own business. Check your local rules for privacy, consent and records.

documents.title: Time-off notice to a client
paragraphs: Notice of {set:company}, dated {today}. Dear {col:clash.first_client}, a short notice about your on-call window.

{col:clash.holder} is away from {col:clash.start} to {col:clash.end}. Your window opens on {col:clash.first_start}. Your doula is {col:clash.first_doula} and your backup doula is {col:clash.first_backup}.
If the dates change we tell you at once. You can reach us on {col:clash.owner_phone}. For anything medical, ask your care provider.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own business. Check your local rules for privacy, consent and records.

documents.title: Response to a due-date request
paragraphs: Letter of {set:company}, dated {today}. Dear {col:requests.name}, thank you for your request of {col:requests.date}.

You asked about a due date around {col:requests.edd_wanted}. The on-call window would run from {col:requests.window_start} to {col:requests.window_end}. We have {col:requests.month_count} due dates booked that month and {col:requests.free_doulas} doulas free. Our answer: {col:requests.verdict}.
If a date is not free we can add you to the waitlist and tell you at once when a place opens. Please call {col:requests.phone} or write back to confirm.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own business. Check your local rules for privacy, consent and records.

documents.title: Waitlist confirmation for a due date
paragraphs: Waitlist confirmation of {set:company}, dated {today}. Dear {col:requests.name}, your name is on our waitlist.
Estimated due date: {col:requests.edd_wanted}, a date you gave us. Service: {col:requests.service}. Area: {col:requests.area}. Received on {col:requests.date}.
A place on the waitlist is not a promise of a place. When a date opens we call you on {col:requests.phone} and you then have a few days to answer. Please tell us if your plans change.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own business. Check your local rules for privacy, consent and records.

documents.title: Backup call-out statement
paragraphs: Backup call-out statement of {set:company}, dated {today}. Backup doula: {col:callouts.backup}. Date: {col:callouts.date}. Client: {col:callouts.client}.

Assigned doula: {col:callouts.assigned}. Outcome: {col:callouts.outcome}. Birth part of the package: {col:callouts.birth_value}. Agency share: {col:callouts.agency_share}, which is {col:callouts.agency_cut}.
Call-out pay for the backup: {col:callouts.backup_pay}. Doula pay after the split and the call-out: {col:callouts.doula_pay}. Amounts are before any tax. Check your contract terms.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own business. Check your local rules for privacy, consent and records.

documents.title: On-call window reminder
paragraphs: Reminder of {set:company}, dated {today}. Dear {col:cover.client}, your on-call window opens in {col:cover.days_to_open} days.

It runs from {col:cover.oncall_start} to {col:cover.oncall_end}. Your doula is {col:cover.doula}, phone {col:cover.doula_phone}. Your backup doula is {col:cover.backup}, phone {col:cover.backup_phone}.
Please save both numbers and tell us if your estimated due date changes. For anything medical, ask your care provider.

documents.title: Busiest weeks summary
paragraphs: Busiest weeks summary of {set:company}, dated {today}. Rank {col:busy.rank}.

Week starting {col:busy.week}: {col:busy.clients_on_call} clients on call, {col:busy.doulas_needed} doulas needed, and at most {col:busy.peak_overlap} windows of one doula. Limit check: {col:busy.flag}, against a limit of {set:max_oncall_overlap}.
Use this page to plan backup cover, time off and new bookings for the week. Write the actions below.
